meta.title: Burn multiple is burn over new ARR
meta.summary: SAMPLE burn $2M, ARR +$1M → 2×. 1–2× efficient; 5×+ expensive growth.

success.message:
Session complete. Burn multiple = net burn ÷ net new ARR. 1–2× vs 5×+.

SAMPLE: $2M/$1M=2×; $5M/$1M=5×.
